## Checklist

- [ ] `go test -race ./...`, `go vet ./...` and `gofmt -l .` are clean
- [ ] Tests added/updated that would fail without this change
- [ ] Doc comments state the contract for any public identifier touched
- [ ] DESIGN.md / README.md updated if a documented decision or contract changed
- [ ] Benchmark before/after numbers included (performance changes only)
- [ ] No new dependencies outside the standard library
